source_evidence: Exact player 'Follow' accepts administrator's invitation and follows him inside the western customs tower for peaceful audience. Cirren and Fenar voluntarily accompany V; Mara remains with healthy coach/four horses in entrance court. Existing antiquarian administrator leads them through open south gate into ground-floor receiving room (fixed40ft square tower, ground hall20ft high, archive upstairs). Newly specified ordinary NPC name Master Aldren Voss and receiving room furnishings (bookshelves, hearth, desk/chairs, preserved maps and faded heraldic banners) consistent with existing prepared administrator; not an added NPC, newly discovered original charter, magical item or proof. Voss introduces himself, offers seating, says Vaishnavi appears in oldest records and asks what led V to believe this tower belongs to him. No V seating decision, disclosure of Silverward/heart, actual records inspected, legal title conceded, new faction knowledge, patrol report, payment, attack, initiative or roll. Guard at gate, second guard in ground hall, Scout roof, Spy archive, same finite roster; no reinforcements. Day333~15:45. V chooses response.
